subtitle.pt: Sistema de rig facial reutilizável para personagens estilizadas
subtitle.en: Reusable facial rig system for stylised characters

summary.pt: Rig facial construído em módulos independentes, para poder ser transplantado entre personagens com topologia diferente. 34 controlos, sem plugins.
summary.en: A facial rig built as independent modules so it can be transplanted between characters with different topology. 34 controls, no plugins.

en.heading: Brief and constraints
en.text: Build a facial rig an animator can pick up without reading documentation, and that survives being moved onto a second head. No third-party plugins, because the lab machines do not have them.

en.heading: The problem
en.text: Blendshape-only faces break as soon as the mesh changes. I split the rig into a joint-driven base layer for the jaw and eyelids and a corrective blendshape layer on top, so only the corrective layer needs rebuilding per character.

description.pt: Sistema de rig facial modular em Maya, com camada base por juntas e blendshapes corretivos. 34 controlos, sem plugins.
description.en: Modular facial rig system in Maya, with a joint-driven base layer and corrective blendshapes. 34 controls, no plugins.
